description: A passive infrared motion sensor with a digital output.
how_to_use: VCC/GND power, OUT is a digital output that goes high when motion is detected and returns low after a delay.

plain.what: Notices when a person or animal moves in front of it (it senses body heat).
plain.how: VCC to 5V, GND to GND, OUT to an Arduino pin. OUT turns on when it sees movement.
